analogy.rationale: USP inhibitors block deubiquitination, indirectly impairing proteasomal degradation and DNA damage repair, so proteasome inhibitors and DNA-damaging agents may partially overlap; however, most cell lines express these USPs at modest levels and the transcriptional consequences are limited, giving a weak overall response.
